name: privateprompt
description: Draft prompts in a local browser vault, then let Codex read the saved file as reference context without requiring the user to paste it into chat.

interface.shortDescription: Draft prompts outside the chat transcript
interface.longDescription: Draft prompts in a local browser page, save them outside the repository, and let Codex read the saved file only after you confirm it is ready. Optional enhancement is performed by a separate Codex CLI run.
defaultPrompt: Open Private Prompt Vault so I can draft a prompt outside this chat
